stories.label: Iran war: Trump coerces allies — threatens Spain trade, UK reverses base refusal
stories.summary: Trump threatens to cut all trade with Spain for refusing base access. UK reversed its refusal, now allowing 'defensive strikes.' Germany cooperating. Pattern: Washington cannot wage this war without European infrastructure and is willing to destroy alliances to get it. Mass funeral for 165 schoolgirls held. Rubio says scope of airstrikes widening.

stories.label: War economic fallout: South Korean won crashes past 1,500/dollar, markets in turmoil
stories.summary: South Korean won breached 1,500/dollar for first time since 2008-09 crisis. Oil still surging, Hormuz still closed, 750+ ships backed up. Economic shockwave now hitting Asian currencies. Trump says Navy will escort tankers 'if necessary.' Central banks constrained by inflation from energy prices.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israel ground assault deepens, Syria deploys troops to border
stories.summary: Syria deploying thousands of troops to Lebanon border — a new state actor entering the conflict zone. Israel told 80+ villages to evacuate. 58,000 displaced in two days. Fragile post-revolution Syrian government stretching thin military despite fighting on three fronts internally.

stories.label: Khamenei succession: Assembly of Experts building bombed during vote
stories.summary: Assembly of Experts building in Qom bombed while votes were being counted. Interim leadership council scrambling. Trump mulling regime change, considering exiled Reza Pahlavi as successor.

stories.label: US Marines fire on Karachi protesters — Pakistan destabilizing
stories.summary: US Marines opened fire on Pakistani protesters. At least 10 killed. Visas suspended. Pakistan-Afghanistan border fighting now in 5th day, 42+ civilians killed. Triple crisis deepening.

stories.label: Russian strikes hit 3-year peak — Iran war diverts global attention
stories.summary: 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. Zelensky fears Iran war will hurt Ukraine. Russia escalating while global attention diverted.

stories.label: Sudan: RSF drone blacks out El-Obeid — war grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: RSF drone strike knocked out power to El-Obeid, North Kordofan capital and key crossroads between RSF-controlled west and army east. Collective punishment of civilian population. War continues with zero global diplomatic bandwidth as Iran consumes all attention. UK court lawsuits against RSF leaders still pending.

stories.label: Milei's legislative blitz: labour reform, criminal age lowered, glacier law weakened
stories.summary: Labour reform passed, criminal age lowered to 14, glacier protections weakened. VP Villarruel says Milei govt wants her to resign.

stories.label: US opens chip door for Vietnam, locks it on China
stories.summary: Washington lifts export controls on Vietnam. Strategic chip supply chain shift to Southeast Asia.

stories.label: Meta smart glasses workers can see everything wearers see
stories.summary: Workers processing Meta smart glasses data can see everything wearers see. Human surveillance behind 'AI' features.

stories.label: Russia to block Telegram in April — 100M+ users
stories.summary: Kremlin says decision is 'final.' Last major channel for anti-war organizing and independent news.

stories.label: British lawyers to sue UAE and RSF leaders in UK courts for Sudan war crimes
stories.summary: UK lawyers will file lawsuits in British courts against UAE and RSF leaders for war crimes.

stories.label: Earth's oldest crystals suggest plate tectonics started 4.4 billion years ago
stories.summary: 4.4-billion-year-old zircon crystals from Western Australia suggest plate tectonics began far earlier than accepted 3-billion-year timeline.

stories.label: Motorola partners with GrapheneOS for privacy-first enterprise phones
stories.summary: First mainstream phone manufacturer to ship GrapheneOS. Announced at MWC 2026.

stories.label: Nepal's first post-protest election March 5 — AI disinformation surge
stories.summary: Nepal votes March 5. New protest-born parties vs old guard. AI deepfakes targeting young voters.

stories.label: Macron expands France's nuclear arsenal, offers nuclear aircraft to allies
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal. Deploying aircraft carrier to Mediterranean, warships to Cyprus after Iranian drone struck UK base.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Total siege continues. All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. Iran war providing cover. Needs dedicated coverage.

stories.label: OpenAI takes Pentagon deal, adds 'no spying on Americans' clause after backlash
stories.summary: OpenAI changed military deal to prohibit spying on Americans after backlash. AI confirmed used in Iran strikes. Anthropic still cut out.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across 5 Middle East countries
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs — mostly women in domestic work — trapped across five war-affected countries. Philippines cannot evacuate at scale.

stories.label: Chile's Kast halts transition with Boric over Chinese subsea cable intelligence
stories.summary: Far-right president-elect Kast suspended handover over Chinese subsea cable project.

stories.label: CBP used online advertising data to track people's movements — no warrant needed
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.

stories.label: EU strips AI, chips and quantum from industrial plan countering China
stories.summary: EU's 'made in Europe' tech policy gutted. Europe choosing dependence on Chinese tech.

stories.label: Quantum proteins: quantum effects found functional in biological systems
stories.summary: Evidence growing that quantum tunnelling and coherence play functional roles in proteins. Biology may have been exploiting quantum effects long before physicists built qubits.

stories.label: Indonesia targets first nuclear power plant by 2032-2034
stories.summary: World's 4th most populous country commits to nuclear energy for the first time. Decades of debate over seismic risk on the Ring of Fire. Hormuz crisis making energy security urgent.

stories.label: FBI using AI as 'game changer' for hacking operations
stories.summary: FBI official called AI a 'game changer' for remote access operations. First official acknowledgment of AI use in offensive cyber operations by US law enforcement.

stories.label: US government iPhone-hacking toolkit leaked to foreign spies and criminals
stories.summary: Coruna toolkit built for US government iPhone exploitation has reached foreign intelligence services and criminal groups. Echoes Shadow Brokers leak that led to WannaCry.

stories.label: Iran civilian death toll climbing, school strike 180+ killed
stories.summary: Death toll 787+ (Red Crescent). School strike toll 180+. Mass funeral held for 165 schoolgirls.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Congress war powers debate pending
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Congress war powers vote still pending.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctioned Rwanda's army chief. Mass graves near Uvira.

stories.label: India-Canada nuclear energy deal resets ties
stories.summary: Canada-India nuclear energy deal. Dramatic reversal after Nijjar assassination fallout.

stories.label: 178+ killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: Death toll rose to 178. MSF staff missing. UN warns of return to civil war.

stories.label: El Niño may return in 2026
stories.summary: El Niño forecast. Would make hottest period ever hotter.

stories.label: AWS data centers in Dubai destroyed by Iranian missiles
stories.summary: Amazon confirms drones damaged three facilities. First time major cloud infrastructure physically destroyed by warfare.

stories.label: Half of nations meet UN biodiversity reporting deadline
stories.summary: First major test of Kunming-Montreal biodiversity framework. Half of nations submitted plans.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — now deploying troops to Lebanon border
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts while also deploying troops to Lebanon border. Iran war complicating everything.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war — day 5, 42+ civilians killed
stories.summary: Cross-border fighting day 5. 42+ civilians killed, 200,000+ displaced. Part of broader Pakistan destabilization.

stories.label: Ultra-sensitive CAR T cells eliminate hard-to-treat tumours
stories.summary: Engineered immune cells detect and destroy tumours that evade conventional immunotherapy. Mouse study.
